description: A Flutter widget implementing a bottom navigation bar with four tabs: Home, Near By, Cart, and Account. Uses Font Awesome icons for the Account tab.

classes.name: BottomNavBarWidget
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that renders a bottom navigation bar for navigating between different sections of the app.

classes.name: _BottomNavBarWidgetState
classes.description: State class managing the selected index and building the BottomNavigationBar widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates an instance of the state object associated with BottomNavBarWidget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the bottom navigation bar UI, managing the selected tab state.

methods.name: _onItemTapped
methods.description: Updates the selected index state when a bottom navigation item is tapped.
